_comment: M2 v2 (docs/SPEC_carry_vce_apply.md) — WIRING SMOKE, arm OFF (the control).
Substrate: _ft63_mdb_raimlive.json, chosen because it is the fast 63-station GPS
config on which the phase-leveling ambiguity carry is actually FOLDED
(phase_leveling true, carry_invariant false).  On a carry_invariant lineage Card 4's
DD carry supersedes the pl carry, so `pl` has no inject site and no monitor rows and
the apply is structurally inert — the loader now warns about exactly that.
This arm is the same-build control for _vceapply_smoke_on.json.  1 h is enough to
catch a wiring fault (does the factor move, does the trace appear, do the products
change AT ALL), and is NOT the card's acceptance: section 7 wants Release 3 h/305 plus
a 12 h window, graded on the calibration ratio.
phase_leveling_var_floor_m2 = 4e-5 (the FT63 lineage value) is set in BOTH arms, so it
is not the A/B variable.  It is here because it is the card's premise: without a floor
the hand fold variance is var_prev + q*dt, which a 20-epoch probe measured at 8.3e-4 m2
against a 9.0e-4 m2 robust carry innovation — a ratio of 1.08, i.e. an already-calibrated
model with nothing for the factor to do.  The 30-120x optimism M2 measured is a property
of the FLOOR, so the floor has to be in the arm for the mechanism to be exercised.
